name: Comic Cafe
source:
Main character is a regular of a certain manga cafe that hires only cute cosplay girls to work here in maid outfits to rise the sales. There is a ticket system here that allows to exchange tickets for a cosplay event of the favorite girl. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是某家漫画咖啡厅的常客。为了提高营业额，店里只雇用可爱的角色扮演少女，让她们穿着女仆装工作。这里还采用票券制度，顾客可以用票券兑换自己喜欢的少女举办的角色扮演活动。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
